legend: Plain axial CT shows a large soft tissue mass arising from the right iliac wing, with bony destruction. Intralesional matrix calcifications are present.
T1-weighted axial MRI shows that the soft tissue mass arising from the right iliac bone is isointense to skeletal muscle.
Contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed T1-weighted axial MRI shows avid heterogeneous enhancement of the mass.

legend: Lobular architecture. In addition to myxoid areas, areas with more hyaline cartilaginous matrix can be seen in a subset of cases.
Moderate nuclear enlargement may be present. The eosinophilic cytoplasmic processes are evident.
Stellate cells embedded in a myxoid matrix are seen on the right, with more-cellular areas containing round cells and multinucleated giant cells on the left.
Note the yellowish-grey, relatively uniform lesion, with sharply demarcated borders and expansion of the bone.
